svg.title: ToneDial screen (npm-permission)
svg.desc:
ToneDial · update
tonedial 0.1.9
Package update: npm update -g tonedial --prefix "<ROOT>/npm prefix" npm update needs write permission (EACCES). <ROOT>/npm prefix Back up your settings and presets, then reinstall in a user-owned directory. Recovery steps: https://github.com/awesometic/tonedial/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md#npm-permissions

g.text: Back up your settings and presets, then reinstall in a user-owned directory.
